usesPermissions.name: Internet
usesPermissions.reason: To send your messages to your Hermes dashboard on your tailnet

plugin.description: Send messages to Hermes Agent, your self-hosted assistant, and read its latest reply. With no chat named, follows the selected settings destination, including an optional persistent ongoing Index conversation. A chat can be named by its title or part of it. Returns a receipt once Hermes accepts the message, not Hermes' answer; use read_latest_reply later for that. Sign in in settings.

actions.name: send_to_agent
actions.description: Send a message to Hermes. Omit chat_id to follow settings; Continue my Index conversation resumes the saved persistent Hermes session (first send creates it). chat_id "new" starts a fresh conversation; a named target is one-off. Preserve a leading New Hermes session, then command in the message if not routing explicitly. Never retry automatically after uncertain delivery.

message.description: What to tell Hermes, without the "tell Hermes" instruction itself.

chat_id.description: A session instanceId, exact title or unique title fragment; "new" starts fresh. Omit to follow settings, including an ongoing Index conversation.

actions.name: read_latest_reply
actions.description: Read Hermes' latest reply in a chat (by instanceId, title or part of one), or in the most recent chat when none is named.

chat_id.description: A chat's instanceId from agent/chats, its title or part of it. Omit for the most recent chat.
